title: Project: Better Server
description: This Plugin adds a lot better funktions to your server, from /kit system to God armor it gives a lot features.
body:
**Project: Better Server adds a lot of useful game-changing features to your Minecraft Server including overpowered kits, tactical weapons, mystical gemstones, and robust backup systems. Perfect for hardcore survival servers, PvP arenas, or creative gameplay experiences.**

> Watch on Youtube the mod interview:
> 
> **This Video is at the moment in Process**
> 
> **_But you can subscribe if you want: https://www.youtube.com/@ZocarProjekt_**

## Features:
> ### Kit System
> > 
> > God Kit & Hacker Kit

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

> > >
> > >God Kit (/pbs kit God-Armor):
> > > >
> > > >
> > > >Gold Silence armor trim on full Netherite set
> > > >
> > > >Complete arsenal: Sword, Mace, Axe, Trident, Elytra
> > > >
> > > >Multi-use Totem: 10 lives with 5-minute regeneration between uses
> > > >
> > > >All items include Curse of Vanishing for high-risk gameplay
> > > >
> > > >God Enchantments all Protections and another enchantmens
> > >
> > >
> > >Hacker Kit (/pbs kit Hacker):
> > > >
> > > >God Kit on steroids with level 255 enchantments
> > > >
> > > >Emerald Silence armor trim
> > > >
> > > >Infinity Totem: 100 auto-regenerating lives
> > >

</details>


> > 
> > Custom Player Kits
> > >
> > >Create and distribute custom loadouts:
> > >
> > >Save any inventory configuration as a reusable kit
> > >
> > >Share kits server-wide or keep them private
> > >
> > >Perfect for events, minigames, or faction loadouts
> > >
> > >Fully configurable permission system
> > >
> 
> ### Gemstone System
> > 
> > Four magical gemstones with unique powers and cooldowns:
> > 
> > Red Gemstone:
> > >
> > >Grants +10 hearts (Health Boost V)
> > >
> > >Strength II for devastating melee damage
> > >
> > >Configurable duration and cooldown
> > >
> > 
> > Blue Gemstone:
> > >
> > >Strikes 3-8 lightning bolts on nearby enemies
> > >
> > >50 block detection range
> > >
> > >Targets both players and monsters
> > >
> > 
> > Violet Gemstone:
> > >
> > >Passive: Apply Levitation curse when hitting enemies
> > >
> > >Active: Launch devastating dragon fireballs
> > >
> > >Dual-function combat tool
> > >
> > 
> > Green Gemstone:
> > >
> > >Speed II, Jump Boost II, Haste II
> > >
> > >Instant Health effect
> > >
> > >Perfect for mobility and quick escapes
> > 
> > 
> > All gemstones feature:
> > >
> > >Visual cooldown tracking via item durability
> > >
> > >Particle effects and sound cues
> > >
> > >Broadcast messages on pickup/drop
> > >
> > >Fully configurable timers
> > 
> 
> ### Orbital Strike System
> 
> > Three devastating tactical weapons with fishing rod technology:
> > 
> > Orbital Nuke
> > >
> > >Spawns 1,500 TNT in expanding rings
> > >
> > >Massive area devastation
> > >
> > >Configurable TNT count
> > >
> > >Visual spawn sequence
> > >
> > >!!!You need to change the max tnt per tick settings on the server in another case the NUKE never work!!!
> > 
> > Orbital Stab
> > >
> > >Vertical explosion column from bedrock to build height
> > >
> > >Pierces through everything in its path
> > >
> > >Perfect for mining or base destruction
> > 
> > Orbital Chunk
> > >
> > >Complete 16x16 chunk deletion
> > >
> > >Removes all blocks except bedrock and obsidian
> > >
> > >Visual particle effects during destruction
> > >
> > >Gradual column-by-column removal
> > 
> 
> ### EnderPearl Chamber
> > 
> > Strategic ender pearl interception system:
> > 
> > Features:
> > 
> > Catch enemy ender pearls mid-flight (10 block range)
> > 
> > Store pearl with original owner data
> > 
> > Throw to teleport the original thrower to target location
> > 
> > Single-use tactical item
> > 
> > Craftable:
> > 
> > ![Crafting rezept eperl stsis champer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d30700873e136463f87d7ee6ff56652692c99c47.png)
>  
>  ### Backup System
> > Comprehensive server backup solution:
> > 
> > Player Backups
> > 
> > Automatic inventory backups every 30 minutes
> > 
> > Manual backup creation for specific players
> > 
> > Enderchest backup support
> > 
> > Stores: Items, armor, health, hunger, XP, location, gamemode
> > 
> > Timestamped files for easy identification
> > 
> > 
> > World Backups
> > 
> > Full world backup as compressed ZIP
> > 
> > Preserves world UID for compatibility
> > 
> > Restore with automatic server restart
> > 
> > List all backups with size and date
> > 
> > Cleanup old backups by date
> > 
> > 
> > Backup Commands:
> > 
> > View backup history per player
> > 
> > Restore specific backup by filename
> > 
> > Create manual backups anytime
> > 
> > Delete old backups to save space
> > 
> 
> ### Advanced Configuration
> > Server Settings:
> > 
> > Custom enderchest sizes (9-54 slots)
> > 
> > Death punishment system (ban/timeout)
> > 
> > Distance-based messages (deaths, joins, quits, chat)
> > 
> > Distance units: Blocks or Chunks
> > 
> > Gemstone Customization:
> > 
> > Individual cooldowns per gemstone
> > 
> > Effect durations
> > 
> > Lightning strike count (Blue Gemstone)
> > 
> > Broadcast message settings
> > 
> > 
> > Orbital Strike Customization:
> > 
> > Cooldown timers per strike type
> > 
> > TNT count for Nuke
> > 
> > Enable/disable reloadable variants
> > 
> > 
> > Kit System Settings:
> > 
> > Allow player-created kits
> > 
> > Permission system for kit usage
> > 
> > Kit sharing options
> > 
> 
> Configuration File
> > Time format:
> > 
> > SE - Seconds
> > 
> > M - Minutes
> > 
> > S - Hours
> > 
> > T - Days
> > 
> > Example: 10M = 10 minutes, 5S = 5 hours
> > 
> > All settings adjustable in-game or via config file for easy server management.
